INSERT INTO crm_wechat_mp_article_draft ( app_id, media_id, index_in_msg, article_type, title, author, digest, content, content_md, content_source_url, thumb_media_id, need_open_comment, only_fans_can_comment, url, synced, published, update_time ) VALUES
( #{row.appId}, #{row.mediaId}, #{row.indexInMsg}, #{row.articleType}, #{row.title}, #{row.author}, #{row.digest}, #{row.content}, #{row.contentMd}, #{row.contentSourceUrl}, #{row.thumbMediaId}, #{row.needOpenComment}, #{row.onlyFansCanComment}, #{row.url}, #{row.synced}, COALESCE(#{row.published}, false), #{row.updateTime} )
ON CONFLICT (app_id, media_id, index_in_msg) DO UPDATE SET article_type = EXCLUDED.article_type, title = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.title, crm_wechat_mp_article_draft.title), author = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.author, crm_wechat_mp_article_draft.author), digest = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.digest, crm_wechat_mp_article_draft.digest), content = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.content, crm_wechat_mp_article_draft.content), content_md = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.content_md, crm_wechat_mp_article_draft.content_md), content_source_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.content_source_url, crm_wechat_mp_article_draft.content_source_url), thumb_media_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.thumb_media_id, crm_wechat_mp_article_draft.thumb_media_id), need_open_comment = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.need_open_comment, crm_wechat_mp_article_draft.need_open_comment), only_fans_can_comment = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.only_fans_can_comment, crm_wechat_mp_article_draft.only_fans_can_comment), url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.url, crm_wechat_mp_article_draft.url), synced = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.synced, crm_wechat_mp_article_draft.synced), -- 同步 upsert 不覆盖本地发布标记；新插入行由 VALUES 中 COALESCE(..., false) 兜底 published = crm_wechat_mp_article_draft.published, update_time = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.update_time, crm_wechat_mp_article_draft.update_time), updated_at = now()
